2 This civil application has been moved for direction to the
respondent State/Land Acquisition Officer, to pay the applicants the amount of compensation, in
view of Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act.
3  The amount of compensation has been determined and is admittedly payable to the applicants.
The respondents are also ready to release the amount in favour of the applicants with a rider that they shall submit some kind of security and preferably bank guarantee.
It is informed by the learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants 2 909 ca.6323.23.odt are poor.
Their entire lands have been acquired for percolation tank.
They are, therefore, rendered landless and doing labour work to earn their living.
As such, they are unable to furnish bank guarantee.
